slides.title: Collaborative Mind Mapping

content_blocks.block_data: Unit 2 · Mind Mapping and Creative Thinking Techniques · 120 minutes · studio · COs 109.4, 109.2

slides.speaker_notes: Studio session. Warm-up: The Silent Map. Do not lecture past 15 minutes.

slides.title: The one idea

content_blocks.block_data: The person who knows least about your business will draw the branch you cannot see.

slides.speaker_notes: Say it once. Do not elaborate on the slide — elaborate out loud.

slides.title: Why it matters

block_data.body: Individual maps first, silently. Only then a shared map. Reversing the order lets one voice set the BOIs for everyone.
Your teammates have never met your owner. Their ignorance is why they will ask the branch you stopped asking.

slides.speaker_notes: Four beats across two slides. Fifteen minutes for all of it.

slides.title: What to do with it

block_data.body: Two people putting the same idea on different branches means the structure is not settled — that is worth more than agreement.
Everyone talks, one draws, and the drawer changes each round.

slides.speaker_notes: Four beats across two slides. Fifteen minutes for all of it.

slides.title: Today you will

content_blocks.block_data: Your team maps each member's anchor in turn. You are the outsider three times and the owner once.

slides.speaker_notes: Leave this slide up for the whole making phase.

slides.title: To close

block_data.head: Pitch
block_data.body: Three minutes. The person, the stuck, the idea, the picture, the ask.

block_data.head: Critique
block_data.body: I like… / I wish… / What if… — the idea, never the person.

block_data.head: Idea log
block_data.body: One page. Silent. Box 4 is the one you read again in week 15.

slides.speaker_notes: If time runs short, cut the input — never the pitch. The pitch is how CO 109.2 is attained.
